info.title: JastipKita API
info.description: JastipKita — Titip Mudah, Aman, Terpercaya. P2P shopping & traveler marketplace API. Money = integer IDR; timestamps = ISO-8601 UTC. Financial mutations require Idempotency-Key.

get.summary: Service health, schema version and integration modes

post.summary: Request a one-time code (SMS / WhatsApp / e-mail)
post.description: LOGIN is public and doubles as sign-up (no account enumeration: the response is identical whether or not an account exists). VERIFY_PHONE / VERIFY_EMAIL require a bearer token. Limits: 60 s resend cooldown, 5/hour and 10/day per destination, 20/hour per IP.

post.summary: Verify a one-time code
post.description: LOGIN → {tokens, user, isNewUser}; a new account requires `consents` (TOS + PRIVACY). VERIFY_PHONE (🔒) raises the account to level 2; VERIFY_EMAIL (🔒) sets the transaction e-mail. 5 wrong attempts lock the challenge.

post.summary: Sign in with Google (ID token)
post.description: Verifies the ID token against Google JWKS (iss accounts.google.com, aud ∈ GOOGLE_CLIENT_IDS, email_verified). Links to an existing account with the same verified e-mail.

post.summary: Sign in with Apple (identity token)
post.description: Verifies against Apple JWKS (iss https://appleid.apple.com, aud ∈ APPLE_CLIENT_IDS). Private-relay e-mails are accepted; `fullName` is only sent by Apple on first authorization.

post.summary: Rotate the refresh token
post.description: Refresh tokens are single-use. Re-using a rotated token revokes the whole session family (theft detection).

post.summary: Log out (revoke the current session)

get.summary: List active sessions

post.summary: Start TOTP enrollment (admins)
post.description: Returns the secret ONCE (stored encrypted). Confirm with a code to activate.

post.summary: Confirm TOTP enrollment
post.description: Activates the factor, returns one-time recovery codes and a step-up access token (mfa_at).

post.summary: MFA step-up
post.description: Verifies a TOTP code (replay-protected) or a recovery code; returns a new access token carrying `mfa_at` for the same session.

get.summary: Current user profile

patch.description: A new transactionEmail is applied only after e-mail OTP verification (see pendingVerification → POST /v1/auth/otp/verify).

post.summary: Switch active mode (BUYER ↔ TRAVELER)
post.description: Always allowed; traveler capabilities (offers, trips) are gated by KYC level on those endpoints.

get.summary: Devices linked to this account

post.summary: Register a device (push token + fingerprint)
post.description: The fingerprint is stored only as an HMAC (multi-account fraud signal). A push token is bound to one install.

delete.summary: Unlink a device (stops pushes, ends its sessions)

get.summary: Consent state and history

post.summary: Record a consent decision (append-only, versioned)
post.description: KYC consent is required before a KYC submission; MARKETING is optional; withdrawal = granted:false.

post.summary: Create a presigned direct upload
post.description: Allowlist: images (jpeg/png/webp/heic) ≤ 10 MB for every purpose; application/pdf also for RECEIPT and TRIP_DOC; video/mp4 ≤ 50 MB for EVIDENCE. PUT the bytes to `upload.url` with `upload.headers`, then call POST /v1/files/{id}/complete.

post.summary: Finish an upload (magic-byte check, SHA-256, malware scan, encryption)
post.description: KYC and TRIP_DOC files are re-encrypted with an AES-256-GCM envelope and the plaintext upload is deleted. Infected files are deleted.

get.summary: File metadata
Short-lived download URL
get.description: Owner and authorized parties only (transaction counterparties for RECEIPT/PRODUCT_PHOTO/DELIVERY_PROOF/CHAT/EVIDENCE). Encrypted files return the authenticated streaming URL.

get.summary: Stream a file through the API (decrypts encrypted files)
get.description: KYC documents require permission kyc.review; access is audited.

get.summary: Account level, requirements for the next level, submissions

post.summary: Submit identity verification (level 3)
post.description: Requires level 2 and a granted KYC consent. ID number, full name and DOB are stored encrypted; one ID document = one account. Documents are file ids with purpose KYC (encrypted uploads). The provider (MOCK auto-decides; manual → IN_REVIEW) drives PENDING → IN_REVIEW → APPROVED/REJECTED.

get.summary: Payout (bank) accounts — masked

post.summary: Add a payout account (bank name inquiry)
post.description: The account number is encrypted; responses only show the mask (****1234). The bank-registered holder name must match the verified identity.

post.summary: Make a verified payout account the default
Request a copy of my data (UU PDP right of access)
post.description: Processed asynchronously; `privacy.export_ready` is emitted when the encrypted JSON export (7-day retention) is available.

get.summary: My privacy requests
get.description: Also available while the account is PENDING_DELETION.

post.summary: Request account deletion (14-day grace period)
post.description: Refused (409 DELETION_BLOCKED) while transactions, disputes, refunds or payouts are open. Otherwise the account becomes PENDING_DELETION, every session is revoked and anonymization runs after 14 days unless cancelled (log in again → POST /v1/privacy/cancel-deletion).

post.summary: Cancel a scheduled account deletion
